messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there — I’ve been going through my rewards statements and something doesn’t seem right with my cash back. Could you help me figure out what’s going on?

I have both a Gold Rewards Card and an EcoCard, and the recent cash back totals don’t seem to add up, but I’m not sure which transactions are off. I also don’t have my phone on me right now to pull up statement details, so I’m hoping you can help on your end.

{
  "message": "Thanks — I can help. To look up your Gold Rewards Card and EcoCard and reconcile the cash back totals I’ll need to access your account, which requires verifying your identity first. Would you like to proceed with verification now? 

If yes, please tell me which identifier you prefer I use to find your account: your email address, your full name (case-sensitive), or your Rho user ID. After I look up your account I’ll ask you to confirm any 2 of these 4 items: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. I will then log the verification (per our security procedures) and review your card transactions and cash back details. 

If you’d rather not verify right now, I can still walk you through steps to troubleshoot the discrepancy yourself. Quick checklist you can try now:
- Confirm both statements’ date ranges (monthly vs. statement closing date) match the totals you’re comparing.
- Check for pending vs. posted transactions (pending ones aren’t included in totals yet).
- Look for returns, refunds, or adjustments that reduce cash back.
- Verify merchant/category changes (some purchases may not have earned the expected category rate).
- Check redemption/credit dates — sometimes cash back posts after the statement period.

Which would you like to do: proceed with verification (and which identifier will you provide), or go through the checklist together?"
}
